title: `Script\ExitReport` has no `memoryPeak`, and the shipped rule that declares it says it does.
text: `rule:observability/script-on-exit` is `shipped`, and its signature block at `docs/rules/observability/script-on-exit.md:15` declares `Script\ExitReport::memoryPeak(): int`. The class at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/script.rs:282` has `reason`, `status` and `error` and no `memoryPeak`. The runtime already records the peak (`rule:observability/a-memory-peak-is-recorded-not-asked-for`, read by `Core\Budget::memoryPeak`). Closing this adds the member, reading the same mark at the moment the exit queue drains, with a conformance case under `tests/conformance/core/`.
